t: Monday – First Day of the week
s: According to the international standard ISO 8601, Monday is considered the first day of the week. Most European countries' calendars show Monday as the first day of the week. However, in many cultures and languages, Monday is given a name that means either “second day,” marking Sunday to be the first day of the week, or a name that means the day after Sunday.
